name: Okazaki Kazuya
source: Kazuya is a uni student and an eromanga maniac. He loves eromanga to the point where he spends all of his free time with them and is even willing to spend his whole food budget to buy more, while his graduation day draws closer and closer. The number of books in his collection is over 1000, and almost all of them are filled with erotic material. In the future, he wants to become an eromanga magazine editor and dreams about delivering eromanga magazines all over the world with his own two hands.
